+"""Batch counter for refresh budgeting."""
+# Refresh performs one query per subnet batch (no extra round trips).
+
+def queries_for_refresh(netuid_count: int, *, batch_size: int = 32) -> int:
+    if netuid_count <= 0:
+        return 0
+    batches = (netuid_count + batch_size - 1) // batch_size
+    return batches + netuid_count  # accidental per-netuid follow-up
